Description

Gee's Original G-40 Minnow Trap

Gee’s G-40 Minnow Trap has been used by fishermen for over 100 years. The semi-collapsible design and entrance hole size is built to conform to most state laws. Sturdy construction using the finest steel and wire. Heavily galvanized and strongly reinforced for years of trouble-free use. G-40 trap is 16.25˝ long assembled; Extended Trap is 31.5˝ long; 9´ maximum diameter. 1/4˝ Mesh. Proudly made in the USA.
